reason: Repair the Penta PR Autopilot production canary failures by making post-lifecycle provider verification GET-only and by adding exact-head workflow-run resolution plus a bounded CI settlement barrier before terminal evaluation. Preserve PentaTagger preflight, PentaPR lifecycle authority, exact-head merge gates, and all fail-closed boundaries.

changes.reason: Replace the post-lifecycle mutating tagger readback with authenticated GET-only verification; resolve workflow_run targets from payload PR or exact head SHA without silently degrading to a sweep; wait boundedly for queued/in-progress exact-head checks to settle before PentaPR terminal evaluation; never rewrite failed conclusions or bypass HOLD/draft/governance boundaries.

exclusions: No merge eligibility requirement is weakened.
No PentaTagger preflight authority is removed.
The settlement barrier waits only for queued/in-progress exact-head checks; completed failures remain failures.
A workflow_run with unresolved or moved head is skipped rather than converted into a broad repository sweep.
No D3 authority, credential, provider permission, payout authority, or money-movement permission is created.
The passive readback performs authenticated GET requests only.
